name: Yoho National Park
policyReason: Leashed pets are allowed, including in the backcountry; some areas are closed to them.
summary: Leashed pets are allowed, including in the backcountry; some areas are closed to them.

excerpts.quote: Pets are welcome in the backcountry but must be leashed at all times.
All domestic animals must be kept on a leash at all times and all fecal waste must be picked up and removed to garbage receptacles.

dogRules.text: Some areas are closed to pets; check notices at trailheads.
Unattended tied-up animals may be impounded.
Check yourself and your pet for ticks after hiking.
